full_name: Sean Graney | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Arts Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow The Hypocrites Theater Company
bio: Sean Graney is a theater adapter/director originally from Saugus, Massachusetts. He is the founding director of The Hypocrites, a Chicago theater company, and was its artistic director for 14 years. Graney has taught at Columbia College Chicago, Lake Forest College, the Theater School at DePaul University, and the University of Chicago.
